question: Does an official Liga MX public no-auth stats API exist, analogous to MLS's stats-api.mlssoccer.com (Sportec) feed?
method: GET https://www.ligamx.net/ (200, 475KB HTML) and read the site's own data-access JavaScript (LMX.js, js/widgets/master.js, js/widgets/portada.js) for the endpoints the official site itself calls.
No guessed endpoints were scraped for data; the probe read only the public pages and scripts the site serves to every visitor.

findings.static_cdn: cldrsrcs.apilmx.com/v1/ serves only static assets (css/js/images/logos) — no data JSON.
findings.data_rpc: The site's data layer is an OBFUSCATED internal RPC: LMX.js builds requests as GET /ws/<base64(service_path)> with '/' replaced by '@' after template substitution (<VARIABLE> placeholders from window.parametros), dataType json; the live-score widget (master.js getMrcdrs) calls /ws/directo/<base64> returning XML whose <JSON> nodes are passed to eval().
evidence_snippets: master.js: urlAjxPlngMrcd = btoa(urlAjxPlngMrcd).replace("/", "@"); $.ajax({ url: "ws/directo/" + urlAjxPlngMrcd, dataType: "xml", success: ... $(data).find("JSON").each(function() { eval($(this)[0].innerHTML); ... })
socket endpoints: https://dksx1d.ligamx.net/bs and /oturl (websocket bootstrap, not a documented API)
findings.why_rejected: Technically no-auth, but there is no documented public contract: service names are base64-obfuscated internal identifiers, responses are eval()'d script payloads, and nothing resembles the stable, versioned, self-describing JSON contract that stats-api.mlssoccer.com provides. Building ingestion on it would be reverse-engineering an internal interface — the same class as scraping, which this project rejects.

consequence: Liga MX ships with ESPN mex.1 as the club+player stats source (per-match summary boxscore, rosters with per-player stats, leaders) and NO official-feed ingestion. No Sportec-style team xG source exists for Liga MX in this stack.
xg_note: ESPN mex.1 summaries carry xG ONLY inside the per-category leaders block (the single leading player's expectedGoals / a GK's expectedGoalsConceded — see ligamx_espn_summary_401877031_2026-07-29.json paths /leaders[*]/leaders[*]/leaders[0]/statistics). Team-level match xG is NOT present in the boxscore team statistics, and per-player roster stats carry no xG, so no credible team xG can be assembled. The model therefore ships goals-only.
